progressionReview: Gateway foundations precede dependent work. HCBCOGN112 precedes Higher Order Functions, and statistical study precedes the research seminar. Machine Learning has no formal prerequisite; prior Data Science would be sensible advice but is not a hard gate. No changed schedule is required.
